parameters.query:
WITH up AS (
  INSERT INTO public.gong_calls (call_id, scheduled_at, primary_user_id, meeting_system, data, summary, ingested_at)
  VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5::jsonb,
          nullif(trim(both E' \n\t' from split_part(split_part($6, '## Brief', 2), E'\n## ', 1)), ''), now())
  ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE SET
    scheduled_at    = EXCLUDED.scheduled_at,
    primary_user_id = EXCLUDED.primary_user_id,
    meeting_system  = EXCLUDED.meeting_system,
    data            = EXCLUDED.data,
    summary         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.summary, gong_calls.summary),
    ingested_at     = now()
  RETURNING *
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, summary, created_at)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'gong'::ltree),
       ('gong.c' || up.call_id)::ltree,
       'directory', up.call_id,
       NULLIF(up.data->>'title', ''), up.summary,
       COALESCE(up.scheduled_at, now())
FROM up
ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE SET
  title   = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.title, resource.title),
  summary = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.summary, resource.summary)
RETURNING id

nodes.name: UpsertGongCall
nodes.notes: Upserts gong_calls (incl. summary = Gong brief) and the gong.c<call_id> resource directory node. Makes new calls browseable via ls immediately.

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, summary, created_at)
  SELECT d.id,
         (d.path::text || '.r' || g.id)::ltree,
         'gong_call', g.id::text,
         left(coalesce(g.metadata->>'title', 'gong call'), 80),
         d.summary,
         coalesce(nullif(g.metadata->>'scheduled_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
  FROM public.gong g
  JOIN public.resource d ON d.kind = 'directory' AND d.path = ('gong.c' || $1)::ltree
  WHERE g.metadata->>'call_id' = $1
  ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
del AS (
  DELETE FROM public.resource r
  WHERE r.kind = 'gong_call'
    AND r.path <@ ('gong.c' || $1)::ltree
    AND r.source_id::bigint NOT IN (SELECT id FROM public.gong WHERE metadata->>'call_id' = $1)
  RETURNING 1
),
led AS (
  INSERT INTO public.ingest_ledger (source, source_id, content_hash, chunk_version, embed_model, status, ingested_at)
  VALUES ('gong', $1, md5(coalesce($2, '')), 1, 'text-embedding-3-large', 'done', now())
  ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO UPDATE SET content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, status = 'done', ingested_at = now()
  RETURNING source_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS leaves_added,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS leaves_removed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM led) AS ledger_written

nodes.name: SyncGongNodes
nodes.notes: Creates gong_call leaf resource nodes for this call’s vector rows (after embedding) and prunes leaves whose vector rows were deleted.

parameters.query:
SELECT j->>'call_id' AS call_id, j->>'title' AS title, j->>'parties' AS parties,
       j->>'sync_status' AS sync_status, j->>'sync_time' AS sync_time
FROM (SELECT $2::jsonb) AS t(j)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.ingest_ledger WHERE source = 'gong' AND source_id = $1
)
